Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir

Class VfpTableBuilder

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir.VfpTableBuilder
public class VfpTableBuilder extends Object
Builds deliverable VFPPROD and VFPINJ tables for Eclipse and OPM Flow from a pluggable lift model.

The builder owns everything around the physics: table axes, evaluation of a VlpProvider at every coordinate, rate-cap handling, repair of infeasible points, physical sanity enforcement, diagnostics and the deck text with a provenance header. The deck formatting and unit conversion is done by EclipseVFPExporter.

Typical gas-well use: 


 VfpTableBuilder builder = VfpTableBuilder.gasWell(1).setDatumDepth(2500.0);
 builder.setRates(VfpTableBuilder.linearAxis(0.2e6, 6.0e6, 8));
 builder.setOutletPressures(VfpTableBuilder.linearAxis(20.0, 90.0, 5));
 builder.setWaterRatios(new double[] {1.0e-6, 2.0e-4, 1.0e-3});
 VfpTableBuilder.Result result = builder.build(new TubingVlpProvider(factory, 2500.0, 0.1));
 result.writeDeck(java.nio.file.Paths.get("vfp1.inc"));

Sanity enforcement is applied in this order and every repair is counted and reported in the result warnings: flowing pressure not below the outlet pressure, flowing pressure increasing with outlet pressure (slope at least setMinThpSlope(double)), and non-decreasing flowing pressure with rate above the minimum of each rate curve (gas-well curves are J-shaped, so the loading side below the minimum is left alone). A rate limit is not representable by a smooth VFP; setRateCap(RateCap, double) replaces the pressure above the cap by a steep penalty slope and records the cap in the deck header.

1.0

    • setRateCap

      public VfpTableBuilder setRateCap(VfpTableBuilder.RateCap cap, double penaltyBarPerUnitOverCap)
      Limits the deliverable rate and replaces the pressure above the limit by a penalty slope.

      For a coordinate with cap Qc, the flowing pressure at rate Q > Qc becomes BHP(Qc) + penalty * (Q / Qc - 1). The simulator then sees a steeply rising lift curve instead of a rate it could produce. The cap is recorded in the deck header and in VfpTableBuilder.Result.getCapPointCount().

      Parameters:
      cap - rate cap function
      penaltyBarPerUnitOverCap - bar added per 100 percent of rate above the cap (for example 200)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • setRateMonotoneMode

      public VfpTableBuilder setRateMonotoneMode(VfpTableBuilder.RateMonotoneMode mode)
      Selects how the rate dependence of the flowing pressure is conditioned. OPM Flow can stall on a table that is U-shaped in rate because the well flips between rate and THP control; use VfpTableBuilder.RateMonotoneMode.FULL for such decks and keep the raw curve for the minimum stable rate report.
      Parameters:
      mode - OFF, ABOVE_MINIMUM (default) or FULL
      Returns:
      this builder

    • setZeroRatioFloor

      public VfpTableBuilder setZeroRatioFloor(double floor)
      Replaces exact zero water and gas ratios by a small positive value when calling the provider. Correlations with a phase-count switch show a pressure jump between exactly dry gas and gas with a trace of liquid; the deck axis keeps the value 0.
      Parameters:
      floor - positive floor in the ratio unit, or 0 to disable (default)
      Returns:
      this builder
